subject: pencil-case creature
pose: 弓起身体，一端提手翘起
art_direction: 弯弯铅笔袋像柔软小兽，拉链齿组成得意笑线，橙色帆布与紫色提手突出。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Turn a curved pencil case into a compact soft creature, arching its orange canvas body as if stretching after a nap. The closed zipper forms a crooked satisfied smile, and a violet carrying loop curls upward like a jaunty ear. Add two small stitched eyes above the zipper and four stubby fabric feet. Show reinforced corners, zipper teeth, and a few seam puckers without filling the scene with stationery. Use a deep blue-green field and directional soft light. Keep the character tactile and slightly lopsided, not glossy plastic. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for distinct original concept, appealing silhouette and expression, requested medium, coherent shape/anatomy, clean visual hierarchy, no text or watermark
